$comment: A record, not a control file. Nothing in @piotr-miller/ai-toolkit reads this file; it exists so a human, or an agent onboarding into this repository, can see which package, tools and exact version own the authoring skills here, without a private dependency and without tracked installation state. The CLI's own state lives in .ai-toolkit/manifest.json, which is gitignored. This repository takes the managed channel only (sync): the recovery channel and Millrune are course-licensed and never installed into a public repository - see README.md, Repository tooling.
